laws.rule: Great Walk huts must be booked in advance on DOC's booking system; international visitors pay higher summer rates (October to April) and DOC staff run random checks at huts. Paparoa Track: international adult NZD 76 to 117 a hut night in summer depending on the hut (about A$93.75 at the top rate, RBA rate of 30 October 2026).

layers.process: Paparoa Track is a 55 km walking or 56.2 km mountain-biking route through Paparoa National Park. DOC says bookings are open for the 2026/27 season; check hut availability and current track alerts before travel. Electric bikes are not allowed.
